description: the covered-cells spec (excel-parity-findings-2026-11-07.md section 1) UNVERIFIED rows: user operations on merged ranges whose covered cells hold content. The case format's sheet_ops has no merge/unmerge/clear/paste/autofill/navigation op, so these are operation scripts on a start workbook. Run each scenario on a FRESH copy of merged-covered-ops.xlsx (build: python3 -I build_merged_fixture.py merged-covered-ops.xlsx). After the op, read the listed range's formulas and values, and the sheet's merged areas. engine = what the engine at the integration commit does (merged/engine-predictions.txt, produced by merged/predict against the same file).
read_api_hint: Office JS: range.formulas, range.values, sheet.getRange(r).getMergedAreasOrNullObject().address (ExcelApi 1.13). Graph REST: GET .../range(address='M!B2:C3')?$select=formulas,values; merged areas need Office JS or desktop VBA (Range.MergeArea / MergeCells).

scenarios.note: Already VERIFIED for import by fixtures/merged-covered-*; this checks the hand-built file loads the same way before the ops.

scenarios.op: Unmerge M!B2:C3 (Office JS range.unmerge(), Graph POST .../range(address='M!B2:C3')/unmerge, desktop Home > Merge & Center > Unmerge)
scenarios.falsifies_if: C2/B3 come back empty (Excel discards covered content on unmerge).

scenarios.op: Clear contents of M!B2:C3 (range.clear('Contents') / Graph POST .../range(address='M!B2:C3')/clear {"applyTo":"Contents"} / desktop select merged cell, Delete)
scenarios.falsifies_if: C2 or B3 survive (Excel clears only the anchor). Desktop Delete on the selected merged cell is the UI form; record both API and UI results if they differ.

scenarios.op: Clear contents of M!B2 only (API address of the anchor alone; the UI cannot express this)
scenarios.note: Distinguishes 'clear walks the merged area' from 'clear walks the addressed cells'. Excel may also expand the address to the whole merge or refuse.

scenarios.op: Copy M!B2:C3, paste (all) at M!J10 (Office JS M!J10:K11.copyFrom('M!B2:C3', 'All') or desktop Ctrl+C / Ctrl+V)
scenarios.falsifies_if: K10/J11 arrive empty (Excel pastes only the anchor of a merged source).

scenarios.op: Copy M!B2:C3, paste at M!C3 (target overlaps the source merge)

engine.result: paste returns Ok but changes nothing: B2:C3 as before, D2:D4 / B4:C4 empty, merges [M!B2:C3]

scenarios.note: Excel either refuses ('cannot change part of a merged cell') or pastes; the engine silently does nothing. Record the error text if refused.

scenarios.op: Cut M!B2:C3, paste at M!J10 (Office JS M!B2:C3.moveTo('M!J10') ExcelApi 1.11, or desktop Ctrl+X / Ctrl+V)
scenarios.falsifies_if: covered content stays behind at C2/B3, or is lost.

scenarios.op: AutoFill M!B2:C3 down to M!B2:C7 (Office JS M!B2:C3.autoFill('M!B2:C7', 'FillDefault') ExcelApi 1.9, or desktop drag the fill handle)
scenarios.falsifies_if: tiled covered cells are empty, or B4/B6 get a progression term (5 is a single number: Excel's FillDefault on one number copies it).

scenarios.op: AutoFill F!B2:C5 down to F!B2:C9 (source has plain B2=1,B3=2,C2=10,C3=20 and merged B4:C5 with anchor B4=3, covered C4=100, B5=200)
scenarios.note: the covered-cells spec (excel-parity-findings-2026-11-07.md section 1): progressions are detected over non-covered cells only (column B 1,2,3 -> 4,5,6; column C 10,20 -> 30,40) and a covered target copies its covered source. Excel may instead include covered values in the trend (B: 1,2,3,200; C: 10,20,100) or treat covered as blank.

scenarios.op: Ctrl+arrow from each start cell (Office JS range.getRangeEdge(direction, activeCell) ExcelApi 1.13 returns the landing range; desktop: select, press Ctrl+arrow, read ActiveCell / Selection.Address)

starts.from: N!B2 (merged B2:D2, empty anchor, covered C2='h')

scenarios.falsifies_if: Excel stops at the merged range B2:D2 / H2:H4 (it would then treat covered content 'h' as making the merged cell non-empty).

scenarios.op: Write 'y' to the covered cell W!C2 by address (Graph PATCH .../range(address='W!C2') {"values":[["y"]]} / Office JS range.values), then write 9 to the anchor W!B2

engine.write C2: refused ("Cannot edit a cell that is part of a merged cell"), C2 stays 2

scenarios.note: the covered-cells spec (excel-parity-findings-2026-11-07.md section 1) 'Editing a covered cell: UNVERIFIED for API writes'. Record the Graph error code if Excel refuses.
